constraints.name: bpay_timesheet_work_key_expression_v1
constraints.definition:
CHECK (NOT bpay_work_key_v1 IS DISTINCT FROM
CASE
    WHEN booking_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(booking_id) <> ''::text THEN booking_id
    ELSE NULL::text
END)
